limitations: Data model presence does not prove field quality or complete source coverage.
Enterprise Security is not required; availability depends on the installed ES version and permissions.
Discovery data does not prove complete system-boundary coverage.
The app does not assume an index or vendor schema; an adapter must provide scope
Identity context is enrichment and does not replace framework-specific access-control evidence.
Change records must identify the affected system and approval state before being used as evidence.

column8: not proof that the underlying control operates.
